_comment: Prompt bank for the Closer recipe (docs/connection-pack-spec.md §2.2). All prompts are original to Lanyard, escalating reciprocal self-disclosure is a public-domain facilitation pattern; no published question text is reproduced. Tier 1 = light/playful, Tier 2 = values/preferences, Tier 3 = reflective (proud-of / gratitude / growth). All school-appropriate. The closer recipe's defaults draw from these; teachers can swap any prompt inline.
tier1: Window seat or aisle seat, and why?
What's the best smell in the world?
If you could only eat one breakfast for a year, what would it be?
What's a movie or show you could rewatch forever?
Would you rather be able to talk to animals or speak every language?
What's the most useless talent you have?
If our class had a mascot, what should it be?
What's your go-to song when you need energy?
Beach day, snow day, or rainy day inside, pick one.
What food do you think is completely overrated?
If you could rename yourself for one week, what name would you pick?
What's the best thing you've ever found by accident?
Would you rather time travel 100 years forward or 100 years back?
What's your ideal Saturday morning?
If you could instantly master one video game or sport, which one?
What's a snack combination you swear by that sounds weird?
What animal do you think would be the funniest if it could talk?
If you opened a tiny shop, what would it sell?
What's the best gift you've ever given someone?
Pancakes or waffles, defend your answer.
If you could add one class to school that doesn't exist, what would it be?
What's a sound that instantly makes you happy?
Would you rather live in a treehouse or a houseboat?
What's the first thing you'd do with a free afternoon and zero homework?
If your life had a theme song this week, what would it be?
What's the weirdest fact you know off the top of your head?
Would you rather have a pet dragon the size of a cat, or a cat that can fly?
What's something small that always makes a day better?
If you could teleport to any place for just one hour, where would you go?
What's the best meal someone in your family makes?
tier2: What's something you've changed your mind about in the last year?
What do you think makes someone a good friend?
If you had a completely free year after school ended, how would you spend it?
What's a skill you'd love to be known for someday?
What's something you find easy that most people find hard?
Who is someone you look up to, and what do you admire about them?
What's a rule you think the world would be better with?
What's something you're curious about lately?
When do you feel most like yourself?
What's a place that feels calm to you?
If you could be great at one thing instantly, would you still want to earn it slowly instead?
What's the best advice you've ever gotten?
What's something you do differently from most people your age?
What kind of teammate are you on a group project, honestly?
What's a tradition, family, friends, or your own, that matters to you?
What's something you used to be afraid of but aren't anymore?
If you wrote a book, what would it be about?
What do you wish adults understood better about people your age?
What's a small habit you have that you're actually proud of?
Would you rather be the best player on a losing team or the worst player on a winning team?
What's something you'd stand in a long line for?
What does a perfect ordinary day look like for you, nothing fancy?
What's a compliment you received that you still remember?
If you could ask your future self one question, what would it be?
What's something you think is worth saving up for?
What part of your week do you most look forward to?
What's a job you'd never want, no matter the pay?
What's something new you tried this year, how did it go?
If your friends described you in three words, what do you hope they'd say?
What's a question you wish people asked you more often?
tier3: What's something you're proud of that you rarely get to talk about?
Who has helped you become who you are, and do they know it?
What's a moment from this year you want to remember in ten years?
What's something kind someone did for you that they probably forgot, but you didn't?
What's something hard you got through that taught you something?
If you could thank one person right now, who would it be and for what?
What's something you want to get braver about?
When was the last time you felt really proud of someone else?
What's a way you've grown this year that nobody noticed?
What's something you hope is true about your life in five years?
What's a mistake that ended up teaching you something useful?
What's something about you that people usually get wrong at first?
What's the most encouraging thing someone could say to you this week?
What's a small win from this month that deserved more celebration?
Who in your life can you be completely yourself around, what makes that possible?
What's something you wish you could tell your younger self?
What's a goal you haven't said out loud yet?
When do you feel most appreciated?
What's something beautiful you noticed recently that others might have missed?
What's one thing you'd never trade about your life, even for something shinier?
What worry turned out to be smaller than it felt at the time?
What's a strength of yours that took you a while to see?
If today were somehow your last day at this school, what would you want people to remember about you?
What's something you're still learning to forgive yourself for, school-sized, not giant?
Who would you most want in your corner on a hard day, and why them?
What's a promise you've made to yourself?
What part of who you are today did you have to work for?
What's something a teacher or coach said that stuck with you?
What does 'home' mean to you, a place, a person, or something else?
What's one thing you genuinely like about how this class feels when it's at its best?
_sets_comment: Named sets for the make page's library (owner 2026-09-26): more ways to get to know each other, all original to Jamyard, no published question text reproduced. The tiers above stay the Closer recipe's defaults.

sets.label: Would you rather?
sets.blurb: Silly either-or picks. Both answer, then argue for your side.
questions: Would you rather be able to fly, or be able to breathe underwater?
Would you rather have a pet dinosaur the size of a cat, or a cat the size of a dinosaur?
Would you rather it be summer all year, or winter all year?
Would you rather only be able to whisper, or only be able to shout?
Would you rather eat pizza for every meal, or never eat pizza again?
Would you rather have a rewind button for your day, or a pause button?
Would you rather live in a treehouse, or on a houseboat?
Would you rather be the best player on a losing team, or the worst player on a winning team?
Would you rather always know the time without a clock, or always know which way is north?
Would you rather have hands for feet, or feet for hands?
Would you rather speak every language, or play every instrument?
Would you rather be ten minutes early to everything, or ten minutes late?
Would you rather have a robot that does your homework, or a robot that cleans your room?
Would you rather never wait in a line again, or never lose anything again?
Would you rather explore the deep ocean, or outer space?
Would you rather have a song play every time you walk into a room, or a spotlight follow you?
Would you rather spend a day as a bird, or a day as a fish?
Would you rather be able to talk to animals, or read minds for one hour a day?

sets.label: Hypotheticals
sets.blurb: Big what-ifs with no right answer. Take a side and defend it.
questions: Who wins: one horse-sized duck, or a thousand duck-sized horses?
If you had to add one rule to the whole world, what would it be?
If you could put one thing in a time capsule for the year 2126, what goes in?
If animals could talk, which one would be the rudest?
If you were given a million dollars but had to spend it all in one day, what would you buy?
If you could shrink to the size of an ant for an afternoon, where would you go?
If a new holiday were named after you, what would people do on it?
If you could swap lives with any character from a book or show for a week, who would it be?
If your school got one free upgrade, what should it be?
If you could invent one gadget that does not exist yet, what would it do?
If you had to live inside a video game for a month, which one, and why?
If you could ask your future self one question, what would you ask?
If gravity turned off for ten seconds every day, how would your morning go?
If you could make one food healthy without changing the taste, which food?
If you had a superpower that was only useful once a year, what would it be?
If you could be an expert at one thing overnight, what would you pick?
If you could redesign the school day from scratch, what would it look like?
If you found a door in your house that was not there yesterday, would you open it?
